verdict.rationale: Cline documents the parts of this loop. It runs terminal commands and tests and reacts to their output live, which covers reproducing and verifying (e.g. "run tests and fix failures"). For narrowing down causes, Plan mode can read the codebase and run searches, and subagents explore the codebase independently and report back. However, no documented debugging or root-cause workflow ties these together, and there is no hands-on evidence of it working. Missing for 10: documented root-cause/debugging workflow, debugger or breakpoint integration, independent hands-on corroboration of the reproduce→diagnose→verify loop.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Executes in your terminal and reacts to output as it appears. Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.
In this mode, Cline can read your codebase, run searches, and discuss strategy
Each subagent gets its own prompt and context window, explores the codebase independently, and returns a detailed report to the main agent.
